title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Twenty-Five Thousand Pesos for the Expenses of the Inauguration of the Government of the Commonwealth of the Philippines.
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Twenty-Five Thousand Pesos for the Expenses of the Inauguration of the Government of the Commonwealth of the Philippines.

text.en:
The sum of twenty-five thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby
appropriated out of the general funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to cover the expenses
necessary or incidental to the inauguration of the Government of the Commonwealth of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 6, 1935.
